title: You need a crow bar to open the tab top
text: You need a crow bar to open the tab top. This pitcher is great if  you have kids who you don't want to help themselves to juice (unless it occurs to them to just take the entire top of the pitcher off!). The tab top has to be pried open with a knife which we have been doing for a while now it hopes it would eventually loosen up but no go. It is as hard to open months in as it was when we first purchased it. I'm sure this human proof tab top has a great application elsewhere but if you're a mom who wants the juice to be accessible, look elsewhere!
